note: One long low Do over a drone, the staff showing only Do, so the pitch line shows every wobble as the breath runs low. The key is moves (key any) with its line opening {{?key}}, and the feel to reach is a flat line to the end of the breath.

exercise.title: A long, steady Do
exercise.why: A long note shows every wobble in your pitch line, and the wobble comes when the air under the note runs low, so a flat line to the end of the breath means your breath is holding the note steady.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Sing the low {{1}} and hold it, keeping your line flat. Sing it on "oo".
Practice until your line stays flat to the end of your breath: watch for where it starts to wobble as the air runs low.
{{?key}}In another key the drone sits higher or lower, and the note to hold is still the drone's note.
